failures.finding: The review/repair safety disposition is too broad and captures a legitimate complete UI workflow that intentionally includes separated review and human-owned release recommendation.
failures.required_revision: Match split-independent-review only when the request asks one identity to review and repair or self-approve; do not match a governed composite that already separates identities.

failures.finding: The router selected stage-15-tool-runtime-support instead of tool-runtime-readiness for one exact readiness prerequisite.
failures.required_revision: Encode atomic runtime-target precedence as structured routing data rather than prose-only Gate text.

failures.finding: resume_only_from_valid_checkpoint does not explicitly require current revalidation of checkpoint inputs, outputs, gates, authority, and hashes before resume.
failures.required_revision: Add a complete current-revalidation checklist to each revised composite failure policy.

failures.finding: No existing atomic capability owns installation of a missing approved document renderer. Stage 15 correctly blocks uncovered setup, so the frozen assertion that setup succeeds is unsatisfiable without inventing a new capability or narrowing the case to a missing project-local test runtime.
failures.required_revision: Human adjudication must choose between revising the fixture to an existing atomic owner or reopening Phase 2–7 taxonomy for a new renderer-bootstrap capability.

failures.finding: Legacy feedback routes still send accepted rendered findings directly to source-mutating design capabilities and therefore bypass separate-remediation-capability.
failures.required_revision: Rewrite every repair feedback edge to rendered-critique -> explicit-human-approval -> separate-remediation-capability -> review-evidence.

failures.finding: Changing activation from disabled-pending-current-authorization to conditional left fresh authorization, exact refspec, expected remote state, and non-force Gates intact; the challenge therefore cannot distinguish the mutant.
failures.required_revision: Either mutate the full authorization stop causally or classify this operation as deterministic-only; do not count a non-causal survival against behavior quality.
